faqs.question: How does the drawdown limit work at Lux Trading Firm?
faqs.answer: Lux Trading Firm utilizes a relative drawdown limit based on the starting balance of your account stage. If your account equity drops below the specified relative drawdown threshold, it constitutes a breach, and the account will be closed.
